relations.rationale: The receding tide described in A directly causes the open sand condition mentioned in B.
The tide receding in the morning has no bearing on the temperature of the air.
The tide receding is unrelated to the difficulty of removing tangled fishing line.
Open sand from the receding tide plausibly enables the group to spread out along the shoreline as described.
The open sand condition doesn't specify which areas need attention, so it neither confirms nor denies Sami's pointing out specific stretches.
Open sand stretches have no logical connection to whether fishing line was tangled or hard to remove.
The tide condition for a beach clean-up has no bearing on how many houses a school has.
Yara arriving first with bags supports the idea that she then began sorting them, since she had the opportunity to do so before others arrived.
Yara arriving first implies others arrived after her, supporting that Dev came later.
Yara's arrival order and bag-carrying has no bearing on who took the photographs.
Yara arriving first with bags is unrelated to the relative arrival times of Ivo and Leo.
Yara arriving first with bags doesn't determine where bags end up stacked later in the day.
Yara sorting bags by size has no bearing on which houses Dev and Leo belong to.
Yara's bag-sorting activity is unrelated to Sami's ranking of teams by litter collected.
Sorting bags near the steps doesn't indicate anything about which team collected the most litter.
Yara's bag-sorting activity has no bearing on the relative heights of Sami and Ivo.
Dev arriving later than Yara is consistent with and supports the detail that he was delayed tying his shoelaces in the parking lot.
Dev's arrival time relative to Yara has no bearing on whether Sami is the lead volunteer.
Dev's late arrival is unrelated to whether Ivo took the photographs.
Dev's arrival time relative to Yara doesn't inform the arrival order of Ivo and Leo.
